title: Advanced snapping framework and indicators
description: Implement a robust, extensible snapping system for surface anchors, fractional face guides, feature/edge anchors, and clear indicator lines. This umbrella tracks architecture, staged delivery, QA, and docs for the full snapping feature set.

title: Add integration drag/snap tests for real interaction flows
description: Add integration tests covering pointer drag flows for part and group snapping across new anchor types, including indicator correctness and overlap-policy compatibility. Include regression cases from user-reported scenarios.

title: Documentation and in-app guidance for advanced snapping
description: Update docs and help content to explain new snap behaviors, indicators, and settings. Add concise in-app hints/tooltips so designers can discover center/quarter-line snaps without friction.

title: Define snap taxonomy, priorities, and indicator language
description: Specify canonical snap types (face, center-1D, center-2D, edge-to-midline, edge-to-quarterline, vertex/edge variants, equal spacing), per-axis arbitration priorities, and visual indicator semantics (color, style, label, precedence). Output is an implementation spec used by all downstream tasks.

title: Implement surface anchor snaps (center-1D, center-2D, edge-to-midline, edge-to-quarterline)
description: Add tangential surface-anchor snap detection on top of face-flush contact: center in one axis, center in two axes, edge aligned to face midline, and edge aligned to quarter-lines. Ensure these work for rotated parts and preserve smooth face-latched sliding.

title: Implement fractional face grid anchors (0/25/50/75/100)
description: Generate and evaluate virtual anchor lines on target faces at configurable fractions. Support one-axis and two-axis snap combinations and preserve existing snap arbitration behavior. Include opt-in setting for advanced fractions if needed later.

title: Build indicator rendering system for snap candidates and winners
description: Implement a consistent indicator layer for snapping: candidate vs winning lines, axis-aware styling, dashed quarter-lines, centerline markers, and short labels near cursor. Ensure indicators are non-interactive and do not interfere with raycasting or dragging.

title: Reference-based positioning and resize rulers
description: Build a first-class reference-positioning system for Carvd Studio so moving and resizing parts/groups relative to reference parts/groups feels explicit, editable, and robust. The feature should promote reference relationships from passive overlays into active in-canvas rulers during transform sessions, support direct numeric editing, behave coherently for groups, and stay compatible with the interaction-architecture refactor and future custom-cut/feature-based geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Users can mark reference parts/groups, see stable and relevant relative rulers while moving or resizing, directly edit active ruler values in-canvas, and get consistent behavior across parts, groups, snapping, overlap prevention, and documentation.

title: Write reference-positioning spec, terminology, and architecture docs
description: Create the canonical implementation spec for reference-based move/resize interactions before deeper code changes. Update interaction architecture docs to define reference entities, selection entities, reference relations, active rulers, passive rulers, move-vs-resize edit semantics, ambiguity rules, and future custom-cut implications. This bead must explicitly include the docs work: update .claude/docs/interaction-architecture-redesign.md, update .claude/docs/interaction-system-blueprint.md, and add a dedicated .claude/docs/reference-positioning-system.md spec.
acceptance_criteria: A durable spec exists that explains the UX, state model, solver boundaries, and documentation updates required for the rest of the epic, and downstream implementation beads can reference it instead of re-deciding behavior ad hoc.

title: Resolve reference and selection entities for parts and groups
description: Replace simplified reference-part handling with explicit entity resolution for references and selections. Treat selected/referenced groups as coherent units, collapse nested groups sensibly, avoid double-counting parts already covered by selected groups, and provide a stable proxy model that later work can evolve from outer bounds to face candidates. Add focused tests for mixed part/group selection, nested groups, disjoint references, and edit-scope edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Shared utilities resolve reference entities and selection entities correctly for parts, groups, and nested structures, and tests lock down the expected semantics.

title: Build reference relation solver and scoring model
description: Create the shared solver that generates candidate reference relations between selection entities and reference entities. Support at least axis gap, axis offset/flush, resize-face-to-reference gap, and dimension-match style relations. Add scoring heuristics that prefer manipulated axes, nearest meaningful gaps, visible outer faces, and stable targets over incidental internal measurements. Document the solver rules in the spec and cover ambiguous cases with deterministic tests.
acceptance_criteria: The codebase has a shared reference relation solver that returns candidate relations plus ranked active recommendations, and its scoring rules are documented and tested.

title: Extend interaction sessions with active reference relation state
description: Integrate reference entities and relations into the shared interaction architecture. Move and resize sessions should carry resolved reference entities, selection entities, candidate relations, the active relation, hover state, and latching metadata so the app can treat reference positioning as a first-class interaction mode instead of an overlay afterthought. Update the architecture docs to reflect the new session lifecycle and state transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Shared interaction session state can represent active reference positioning during move and resize flows, and the updated architecture docs describe that lifecycle clearly.

title: Refactor reference indicators into a richer ruler overlay model
description: Replace or evolve the current reference distance indicator model so the overlay system can render passive rulers, active rulers, hovered rulers, and editable rulers with distinct semantics. The new model must support move-relative rulers, resize size rulers, and resize gap rulers without conflating them. Update overlay components and related types/stores to read from the shared interaction session model rather than bespoke snap-store-only assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace can render a richer reference ruler model with clear passive/active/editable states, and the overlay architecture no longer depends on the old flat distance-indicator assumptions.

title: Implement active move-relative rulers with direct numeric editing
description: Upgrade move interactions so reference relations become the active control surface during drag. Idle selection may still show lightweight passive rulers, but move sessions should promote the most relevant relation into a highlighted active ruler that updates live and supports direct numeric entry. Typed edits must solve movement from relation semantics instead of only moving along a raw line vector, and must respect snapping, ground constraints, and overlap prevention.
acceptance_criteria: While moving parts or groups relative to references, the user gets a stable active ruler that can be edited directly in-canvas to set precise spacing or offset with correct transform results.

title: Implement resize-relative size and gap rulers with direct editing
description: Bring resize onto the same reference-positioning model. When a resize handle is active, show both the manipulated size ruler and the active gap-to-reference ruler where applicable, and let the user edit either one explicitly. Gap edits should resize the moving face relative to the chosen reference face/entity while honoring anchor side, stock constraints, snapping, and overlap behavior. The UX must make it obvious whether a typed value changes part size or spacing.
acceptance_criteria: Resize sessions can expose editable size and gap rulers, and typing a value into either produces the expected constrained resize behavior with clear UX.

title: Improve group reference proxies, target ambiguity, and relation latching
description: Polish the hard UX cases for references. Improve how groups act as reference targets so they feel like coherent objects instead of arbitrary descendant unions, add better proxy/outer-shell behavior where needed, and formalize ambiguity resolution and hysteresis so active rulers do not flicker between competing targets. Document the winning-target rules and future face-candidate roadmap in the reference-positioning spec.
acceptance_criteria: Group references feel coherent, active target choice is stable and explainable, and ambiguity/latching behavior is documented and covered by focused tests.

title: Add regression coverage, in-app guidance, and final docs for reference positioning
description: Finish the epic with focused automated coverage, changelog updates, and user-facing guidance. Add tests for entity resolution, relation solving, move-relative editing, resize-relative editing, ambiguity/latching, and group-reference behavior. Update CHANGELOG.md and the reference-positioning docs to reflect the shipped behavior, and add concise in-app hints or guidance so users discover how to work with active rulers and typed reference edits.
acceptance_criteria: The reference-positioning workflow is covered by focused tests, user-visible docs and in-app guidance are updated, and CHANGELOG.md records the user-facing improvements.

title: Extend snap arbitration and hysteresis for advanced anchors
description: Update per-axis snap arbitration to handle new anchor snap types with stable precedence and hysteresis. Prevent oscillation between similar candidates and preserve smooth tangential slide while face-latched.

title: Add snap settings UI and presets for advanced snapping
description: Expose settings to enable/disable anchor families, adjust sensitivity, and choose indicator verbosity (winners only vs show candidates). Provide sensible presets: Simple, Precision, Layout.

title: Add performance instrumentation and budgets for snapping
description: Instrument snap detection and indicator rendering cost in drag loops. Add performance budgets and guardrails to keep interaction smooth with many parts/groups. Optimize candidate pruning and early exits where needed.

title: Comprehensive unit tests for advanced snap detectors
description: Add deterministic tests for surface anchors, quarter-lines, centerline snaps, edge/vertex interactions, and arbitration precedence. Include scenario fixtures for rotated parts and face-latched sliding without regressions.
